name: openai-agents-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is the OpenAI Agents SDK (`openai-agents`), a Python framework for multi-agent
workflows. Its core runtime defines agents with instructions, tools, handoffs, guardrails, output types and model
settings; runs them in a loop through `Runner` with run configuration, lifecycle hooks, error handlers and a turn
limit; records the items, results and token usage that a run produces; and keeps conversation history in sessions.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the core runtime of the OpenAI Agents SDK under src/agents/: the modules agent.py, agent_output.py, run.py, run_config.py, run_context.py, run_error_handlers.py, result.py, items.py, guardrail.py, tool_guardrails.py, function_schema.py, strict_schema.py, lifecycle.py, usage.py, exceptions.py, model_settings.py and stream_events.py, the packages src/agents/handoffs/, src/agents/run_internal/ and src/agents/util/, and src/agents/memory/ except openai_conversations_session.py and openai_responses_compaction_session.py, together with docs/agents.md, docs/running_agents.md, docs/handoffs.md, docs/guardrails.md, docs/results.md, docs/context.md, docs/usage.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation t
